label: phage defense system
definition: A genomics trait describing possession of one or more bacterial or archaeal immune systems that inhibit bacteriophage infection.
observations: Umbrella GENOMICS parent for CRISPR-Cas, restriction-modification, BREX, DISARM, abortive-infection, CBASS, and related antiphage systems; distinct from individual proteins, phage counter-defense mechanisms, surface receptor loss, prophage possession by itself, and source database rows naming one locus.
